R Notebook

Data Preparation

Reads the two datasets and joins the Vs30 data to the main dataset based on the nearest Vs30 data point.

library(arrow)
library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaps)
library(lme4)
library(here)
library(viridis)

data <- read_parquet(
  here("data_processed", "NZ_FR_IAR_final_dataset.parquet")
)


data <- data |>
  drop_na(
    Rhypo_km,
    Mw,
    Vs30_raw,
    event_depth_km,
    publicid
  )


# filters the dataset to the decided upon report count
data_sd <- data |>
  filter(report_count >= 4)

Box-Cox Model

Trying out other predictors and applying best subset selection.

model_bc <- regsubsets(
  reported_mmi ~ event_depth_km + Rhypo_km + Vs30_raw + Mw + geonet_catalogue_magnitude,
  data = data_sd,
  nvmax = 4
)

Checking Vs30 data as no model wants to use it

Uses a Box-Cox transformation to find the most suitable transformation of felt_mmi_median_cells for only Vs30.

bc <- boxcox(
  lm(reported_mmi ~ Mw + Rhypo_km + geonet_catalogue_magnitude + Vs30_raw, data = data_sd)
)


best_lambda <- bc$x[which.max(bc$y)]
best_lambda
[1] -0.3434343

Filtering Felt Reports

With the selected variables applies a Box-Cox analysis to determine the most suitable transformation for the filtered data.

model_lr_bc <- boxcox(
  lm(reported_mmi ~ event_depth_km + Rhypo_km + Vs30_raw + Mw, data = data_sd)
)


best_lambda <- model_lr_bc$x[which.max(model_lr_bc$y)]
best_lambda

unzip("statsnz-regional-council-2025-clipped-GPKG.zip", exdir = "nzmap")
nzmap <- st_read("nzmap/regional-council-2025-clipped.gpkg")

# Choose earthquake
earthquake_id <- "2021p169083"


# Get data for selected earthquake
eq_data <- data_sd |>
  filter(publicid == earthquake_id)

# Predicted MMI at actual Felt RAPID locations
#
# re.form = NULL includes the random effect for this earthquake

eq_data$predicted_mmi <- exp(
  predict(
    model_mem_3,
    newdata = eq_data,
    re.form = NULL
  )
)

# Convert Felt RAPID locations to spatial points

eq_sf <- eq_data |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c(
      "report_longitude",
      "report_latitude"
    ),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  st_transform(2193)

# Get earthquake epicentre
earthquake <- eq_data |>
  slice(1) |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c(
      "event_longitude",
      "event_latitude"
    ),
    crs = 4326
  ) |>
  st_transform(2193)

# Convert NZ map to NZTM
nz_nztm <- nzmap |>
  st_transform(2193)


# Values for this earthquake
mw_value <- eq_data$Mw[1]

depth <- eq_data$event_depth_km[1]

# Hold Vs30 constant so predicted regions can be circular
vs30_value <- median(
  eq_data$Vs30_raw,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Generate predicted MMI over hypocentral distance
#
# Start at earthquake depth because when epicentral distance
# is zero:
#
# Rhypo = depth
#
# Predict out to 1000 km so lower MMI boundaries can be found.
prediction_data <- tibble(
  Rhypo_km = seq(
    from = depth,
    to = 10000,
    by = 0.1
  ),
  Mw = mw_value,
  Vs30_raw = vs30_value,
  publicid = earthquake_id
)

prediction_data$predicted_mmi <- exp(
  predict(
    model_mem_3,
    newdata = prediction_data,
    re.form = NULL
  )
)

# Check prediction range
minimum_predicted <- min(
  prediction_data$predicted_mmi,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

maximum_predicted <- max(
  prediction_data$predicted_mmi,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(
  c(
    minimum_predicted = minimum_predicted,
    maximum_predicted = maximum_predicted
  )
)
minimum_predicted maximum_predicted 
      0.004245149       5.558782591 
# Define boundaries between integer MMI categories
#
# For example:
#
# 3.5 separates MMI 3 and MMI 4
# 4.5 separates MMI 4 and MMI 5
# 5.5 separates MMI 5 and MMI 6
mmi_boundaries <- seq(
  1.5,
  7.5,
  by = 1
)


# Only keep boundaries that the model actually crosses
mmi_boundaries <- mmi_boundaries[
  mmi_boundaries >= minimum_predicted &
  mmi_boundaries <= maximum_predicted
]

# Find hypocentral distance where each boundary occurs
ring_distances <- map_dfr(
  mmi_boundaries,
  function(boundary) {

    closest <- prediction_data |>
      slice_min(
        abs(predicted_mmi - boundary),
        n = 1,
        with_ties = FALSE
      )

    tibble(
      boundary = boundary,
      Rhypo_km = closest$Rhypo_km,
      predicted_mmi = closest$predicted_mmi
    )
  }
)

# Convert hypocentral distance to horizontal map distance
#
# Rhypo^2 = Repi^2 + depth^2
#
# Therefore:
#
# Repi = sqrt(Rhypo^2 - depth^2)
ring_distances <- ring_distances |>
  mutate(
    radius_km = sqrt(
      pmax(
        Rhypo_km^2 - depth^2,
        0
      )
    )
  )

# Check boundary distances
print(ring_distances)
# A tibble: 5 × 4
  boundary Rhypo_km predicted_mmi radius_km
     <dbl>    <dbl>         <dbl>     <dbl>
1      1.5   1852            1.50    1852. 
2      2.5   1143.           2.50    1142. 
3      3.5    675.           3.50     675. 
4      4.5    326.           4.50     325. 
5      5.5     47.8          5.50      34.6
# Create spatial circles
ring_geometry <- lapply(
  ring_distances$radius_km,
  function(radius) {

    st_buffer(
      st_geometry(earthquake),
      dist = radius * 1000
    )[[1]]

  }
)


rings <- st_sf(
  boundary = ring_distances$boundary,
  radius_km = ring_distances$radius_km,
  geometry = st_sfc(
    ring_geometry,
    crs = 2193
  )
)

# Create labels for predicted MMI regions

# Get earthquake coordinates
epicentre_coords <- st_coordinates(earthquake)[1, ]

# Order boundaries from smallest radius to largest
label_data <- ring_distances |>
  arrange(radius_km)

# Create inner and outer radius of each region
region_edges <- c(
  0,
  label_data$radius_km,
  max(label_data$radius_km) + 100
)

# MMI at the centre of each region
centre_mmi <- round(maximum_predicted)

region_labels <- tibble(
  mmi = centre_mmi - seq_along(head(region_edges, -1)) + 1,
  radius_km = (
    head(region_edges, -1) +
    tail(region_edges, -1)
  ) / 2
)

# Put labels to the east of the epicentre
region_labels_sf <- st_as_sf(
  region_labels |>
    mutate(
      x = epicentre_coords[1] + radius_km * 1000,
      y = epicentre_coords[2],
      label = paste("MMI", mmi)
    ),
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 2193
)

mmi_map <- ggplot() +

  geom_sf(
    data = nz_nztm,
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "grey60"
  ) +

  # Predicted MMI boundaries
  geom_sf(
    data = rings,
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  # Observed reported MMI - smaller points
  geom_sf(
    data = eq_sf,
    aes(colour = reported_mmi),
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # Predicted MMI region labels
  geom_sf_label(
    data = region_labels_sf,
    aes(label = label),
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    fill = "white"
  ) +

  # Earthquake epicentre
  geom_sf(
    data = earthquake,
    shape = 4,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.5
  ) +

  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    limits = c(3, 8),
    breaks = 1:8,
    name = "Reported MMI"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Observed and Predicted Earthquake Intensity",
    subtitle = paste("Earthquake:", earthquake_id),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal()

# Display map
mmi_map

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(
    "MMI_map_",
    earthquake_id,
    ".png"
  ),
  plot = mmi_map,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
